evidence.summary: 核查 README.md、src/index.ts、runtime/gate.py、addon/dsh_blender_bridge.py；DSH工具经loopback后端和addon执行Python/取帧，支持持久headless fallback及多态验收gate。
limitations: 只读固定源码与作者安装材料；未运行Blender、addon、目标脚本/测试，未做视觉、加工或宿主验收。
只执行本工程的统计和结构验证；没有执行目标插件、测试、安装或真实宿主验收。
GitHub/npm 活跃度只作采集背景，未核实独立用户采用或同条件收益对照。

findings.text: 具备Blender验收能力的创作者在持久场景中迭代建模并核对视觉与几何交付。
DSH工具经loopback后端和addon执行Python/取帧，支持持久headless fallback及多态验收gate。
只读固定源码与作者安装材料；未运行Blender、addon、目标脚本/测试，未做视觉、加工或宿主验收。
原生DSH工具包并有Blender addon及runtime，不能只装根插件便认为GUI桥已就绪；未全量核对lib与src一致。

### 成本

| 阶段 | 现金／资源 | 人工／时间 |
|---|---|---|
| 首次 | Node/DSH/Blender资源，未知 | addon、profile与场景配置，未知 |
| 持续 | 渲染、模型调用、存储，未知 | 视角/几何/导出复核，未知 |
| 失败恢复 | 部分渲染与重试资源，未知 | 备份恢复、GUI/worker对账，未知 |
[Q04](#research-q04) 当前观察；先用一次性.blend场景验证GUI连接、暂停、headless和响应中断后状态，未核清前不直接接生产资产。

### 效果

| 任务 | 源码支持 | 缺口 |
|---|---|---|
| 持久迭代 | Python执行与取帧入口 | 实际帧延迟、任务质量 |
| 验收交付 | skipped/degraded不放行 | 检查范围和已知缺陷检出率 |
gate空包不通过、取消signal传递值得复用；但客户端取消网络不等于撤销Blender修改，迁移必须设计请求对账而非盲目fallback。
[Q01](#research-q01)、[Q03](#research-q03) 将持久Python、实时取帧与不把skipped/degraded当pass的验收语义连接，增量是可见迭代和明确交付边界，未证明任务质量或速度胜出。
[Q02](#research-q02) /act请求异常后的worker fallback不能证明GUI未执行，也不能保证两个场景等价；在响应未知时必须先对账，持久修改可能已发生。
[Q05](#research-q05) 未验证假设是场景revision与请求票据绑定、超时先查状态后重试，用响应丢失实验比较重复修改、错配和恢复成本；成本过高或无改善即停止。

technical.rationale: Q01—Q03中Blender桥和Python为常规集成，novelty25%；持久视觉闭环与未决gate使操作/验收取舍明确，mechanism50%；多态gate可迁移但依赖后端，transferability50%；同入口观察修改simplification50%，未见直接对照支持75%。

business.rationale: workflow/delivery50%把离线脚本改为观察迭代和可审查交付；仍需Blender和技术验收能力，reach25%；渲染和重试资源未知，economics25%仅局部减少切换，不宣称ROI。

recommendation.reason: 具备Blender与脚本排障能力的技术美术可先观察并在一次性场景验证连接和修改链路。相对离线脚本，它提供持续取帧和明确未决gate，但未知响应后的场景一致性尚未核清。若/act超时或GUI与worker结果不符，应停止自动重试并回到Blender备份和人工操作。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 人群、迭代任务与多条件交付明确，50%超过潜在便利；需求痛点与持续采用仍无直接用户结果，不取75%。

advantage.rationale: [Q03](#research-q03) 观察迭代与未检查降级比只发脚本有具体机制，50%超过入口包装；视觉覆盖和端到端收益未知，不取75%。

evidence.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)、[Q03](#research-q03) 入口、执行、取消、fallback和gate可定位，50%超过片段；未运行不取75%，重要恢复疑问使结论observe。

cost.rationale: [Q04](#research-q04) 多层环境、持久修改和未知结果对账负担具体，25%有支持；缺少已验恢复/退出使50%的可行全链路退路尚不充分。

# DSH × Blender > 将DSH连接到Blender GUI或持久无头会话，执行建模、取帧、检查和导出。 ## 研究范围 - **仓库**：[sixtysevenlf/dsh-blender-plugin](https://github.com/sixtysevenlf/dsh-blender-plugin) - **版本号**：2.6.1（[固定提交 f9f115f86b3c40fbe8d3dba811283acf71df03f9](https://github.com/sixtysevenlf/dsh-blender-plugin/tree/f9f115f86b3c40fbe8d3dba811283acf71df03f9)） - **版本日期**：2026-10-26（固定提交日期，北京时间；不是包发布日期） ## 结论状态 已核查工具、HTTP取消、addon执行与gate聚合；未运行，未知结果风险未复现，票据快照是假设。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：具备Blender验收能力的创作者在持久场景中迭代建模并核对视觉与几何交付。 - **亮点**：[Q01](#research-q01)、[Q03](#research-q03) 将持久Python、实时取帧与不把skipped/degraded当pass的验收语义连接，增量是可见迭代和明确交付边界，未证明任务质量或速度胜出。 - **思考**：[Q02](#research-q02) /act请求异常后的worker fallback不能证明GUI未执行，也不能保证两个场景等价；在响应未知时必须先对账，持久修改可能已发生。 - **建议**：[Q05](#research-q05) 未验证假设是场景revision与请求票据绑定、超时先查状态后重试，用响应丢失实验比较重复修改、错配和恢复成本；成本过高或无改善即停止。 采用建议：[Q04](#research-q04) 当前观察；先用一次性.blend场景验证GUI连接、暂停、headless和响应中断后状态，未核清前不直接接生产资产。 ## 核心贡献 [Q01](#research-q01)、[Q03](#research-q03) 将持久Python、实时取帧与不把skipped/degraded当pass的验收语义连接，增量是可见迭代和明确交付边界，未证明任务质量或速度胜出。 ## 关键质疑 [Q02](#research-q02) /act请求异常后的worker fallback不能证明GUI未执行，也不能保证两个场景等价；在响应未知时必须先对账，持久修改可能已发生。 ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 [Q05](#research-q05) 未验证假设是场景revision与请求票据绑定、超时先查状态后重试，用响应丢失实验比较重复修改、错配和恢复成本；成本过高或无改善即停止。 隔离.blend中注入响应丢失并核对GUI/worker，另对已知视觉和装配缺陷测gate覆盖；未执行。 ## 场景与替代办法 具备Blender验收能力的创作者在持久场景中迭代建模并核对视觉与几何交付。 人工Blender或单次Python脚本是简单基线；不把作者调用毫秒数当端到端建模收益。 ## 依赖与流程 ### 启动与依赖 | 条件 | 用途 | 退路 | |---|---|---| | DSH与Node20+ | 工具及后端 | 先确认匹配版本 | | Blender4/5与GUI addon | 执行和图像反馈 | headless需单独场景核对 | | 备份与人工验收 | 控制持久修改风险 | 未知结果先查原场景 | ### 启动步骤 | 步骤 | 执行者与判据 | 失败处理 | |---|---|---| | 一次性场景连桥 | 用户按GUI doctor核对 | 不以health代完整验收 | | 小改动后取帧 | 用户确认同一场景和视角 | 未知响应先查结果 | | 几何与导出验收 | 创作者核对目标标准 | degraded/skipped不交付 | ## 成本与效果 ### 成本 | 阶段 | 现金／资源 | 人工／时间 | |---|---|---| | 首次 | Node/DSH/Blender资源，未知 | addon、profile与场景配置，未知 | | 持续 | 渲染、模型调用、存储，未知 | 视角/几何/导出复核，未知 | | 失败恢复 | 部分渲染与重试资源，未知 | 备份恢复、GUI/worker对账，未知 | ### 效果 | 任务 | 源码支持 | 缺口 | |---|---|---| | 持久迭代 | Python执行与取帧入口 | 实际帧延迟、任务质量 | | 验收交付 | skipped/degraded不放行 | 检查范围和已知缺陷检出率 | ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标**：核查Blender持久观察修改闭环、验收语义与未知执行结果边界。 ### Q01 · GUI与headless闭环适合什么3D任务？ **研究主题**：场景与需求、采用判断 #### 完整回答 面向已有Blender基础、能判断场景结果的3D创作者或技术美术，在同一GUI场景中让Agent观察画面、执行局部Python并再次看图；没有GUI时用持久headless worker。合格交付应同时满足约定视角下的外观、装配几何及导出可用性，而不是只拿到一张帧或工具ok。简单基线是人工Blender操作或一次性Python脚本。增量在持续会话的观察—局部修改—再观察，能发现离线脚本难以直接看到的问题，但美术质量与几何可靠性仍需人制定验收。作者报告的毫秒级时延未独立复现，也不能代表完整建模任务耗时。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[README.md:5-5](https://github.com/sixtysevenlf/dsh-blender-plugin/blob/f9f115f86b3c40fbe8d3dba811283acf71df03f9/README.md#L5-L5) 作者限定GUI优先与持久headless fallback。 ```text DSH × Blender connects DeepSeek Harness to Blender so an agent can build, inspect, validate, and export 3D scenes in a real Blender session. The normal workflow is GUI-first: start Blender, connect the addon, and let the agent look, change, and verify. When no GUI is available, a persistent headless session provides the same interactive loop, including frames. ``` **依据 2 · 作者声明**：[README.md:19-27](https://github.com/sixtysevenlf/dsh-blender-plugin/blob/f9f115f86b3c40fbe8d3dba811283acf71df03f9/README.md#L19-L27) 功能主张中的观察、装配和同视角验收，未当运行证据。 ```text - **GUI-first interactive modeling.** The agent works against the Blender session you are looking at. It can inspect the scene, run Python in a persistent kernel, take a viewport or custom-angle frame, and iterate one step at a time. - **Headless fallback with visual feedback.** If Blender has no GUI, start a persistent worker and the agent can still execute code and get Workbench frames. This is a fallback path, not the default; it exists so the agent is never blind. - **Reference-image measurement.** Measure silhouettes, holes, symmetry, readable features, and scale from a reference image before modeling. If no scale is known, the tools return pixel units instead of inventing millimeters. - **Assembly audit and repair.** Validate an assembly manifest, classify clashes, hidden overlaps, contacts, gaps, floating parts, and contained parts, apply safe repairs, gate the result, and export GLB, FBX, or OBJ with a manifest and merge ledger. - **Blockout and video-reference packs.** Build low-poly blockouts from declarative parts, render orthographic and perspective reference views, and produce a turntable MP4 for video models such as Seedance. - **Visual acceptance and delivery gates.** Compare renders against references from the same camera, report defects with crops and measurements, run defect-injection evaluation, and block delivery when the gate is not pass. - **Automation and long jobs.** Run one-shot headless scripts, long background jobs, parameter searches, and batch validation without occupying the GUI. - **Native selection.** Select objects or collections in Blender and send them into the current DSH draft. ``` **依据 3 · 源码核查**：[src/index.ts:1682-1707](https://github.com/sixtysevenlf/dsh-blender-plugin/blob/f9f115f86b3c40fbe8d3dba811283acf71df03f9/src/index.ts#L1682-L1707) do工具声明持久执行、可取帧及非并发安全。
查看原文（26行） ```text ctx.effect(() => ctx.tools.register(vTool({ name: 'blender_rt_do', description: '实时驱动 Blender：在持久内核 K 里执行 Python（或直接跑 .py 文件），可选立刻回一帧视口。只补 op 没有的局部编辑；有 plan op 先用 op。' + 'GUI 可用时走 addon；传 session 时在持久无头 worker 里 exec+see（GUI 不可达自动降级，不是异步 job）；每步约 50–150 ms。' + HINT_KERNEL + ' 异常也会回传 partial stdout / stderr / traceback（诊断信息不丢）；' + ' file 参数可直接执行工作区脚本（等价 K.run(path)，支持 WSL / Windows / 相对 .blend 三种路径）；' + ' 内置路径辅助 K.win_path / K.wsl_path / K.blend_path / K.out_dir；' + ' ④ 返回的 ms 即**主线程占用**，>1 s 会提示改走 blender_rt_headless / blender_rt_worker。' + ' **P0 无头交互**：GUI 不在线或传 session 时，自动降级到持久无头会话（exec + Workbench see，同一 worker 热路径；不是 job/异步）。' + '第一次会冷启动 worker，之后每步 ~50–150ms；session 名固定即复用同一个 Blender 会话。', parameters: { code: { type: 'string', description: 'Python 代码（在 Blender 主线程执行；预置 bpy/math/mathutils/Vector 与持久内核 K）。与 file 二选一' }, file: { type: 'string', description: '要执行的 .py 文件路径（WSL / Windows / 相对当前 .blend 均可）—— 长脚本用这个，不必塞进入参' }, see: { type: 'boolean', description: '是否同时回一帧视口（默认 true）' }, max_size: { type: 'integer', description: '回帧最长边像素，默认 560' }, force: { type: 'boolean', description: '回帧与上一帧 hash 完全相同时默认**不重复附图**；传 true 强制重发' }, session: { type: 'string', description: '无头交互会话名（复用同一 blender -b）' }, auto: { type: 'boolean', description: 'GUI 不可用时降级无头 session（默认 true）' }, preload: { type: 'string', description: '无头 session 预载模块（逗号分隔）' }, from: { type: 'string', description: '无头 see 相机位置 "x,y,z"' }, look_at: { type: 'string', description: '无头 see 看向点 "x,y,z"' }, }, output: { schema: ANY_SCHEMA, render: renderOne }, isConcurrencySafe: () => false, timeoutMs: T.act, ```
### Q02 · 工具如何执行代码，取消与fallback有哪些边界？ **研究主题**：功能与机制、依赖、兼容与流程 #### 完整回答 apply注册包内Skill、解析配置并可自动启动后端；工具通过loopback HTTP连接后端，再由Blender addon主线程执行Python。do可传code或file，有session则直用持久headless；GUI/act请求抛异常且auto未关闭时尝试doViaSession。这是真实修改场景和执行任意Python的权限面，不能当只读建模建议。withTimeout组合宿主signal与本地超时会取消fetch，但不证明已发送的Blender操作回滚或停止。关键风险是/act响应丢失或超时后，GUI可能已经产生副作用，而fallback在另一worker重做；两个会话场景也不必相同。因此未知结果先核对原场景再重试，不能直接将fallback成功当原GUI已完成。未进行故障复现，此为源码可见条件风险。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[src/index.ts:454-473](https://github.com/sixtysevenlf/dsh-blender-plugin/blob/f9f115f86b3c40fbe8d3dba811283acf71df03f9/src/index.ts#L454-L473) 超时与宿主取消作用于fetch链路。
查看原文（20行） ```text async function withTimeout(path: string, init: any, timeoutMs: number): Promise { const ac = new AbortController() const ext = execSignal() let fired = false const timer = setTimeout(() => { fired = true; ac.abort() }, timeoutMs) const signal = ext ? AbortSignal.any([ext, ac.signal]) : ac.signal try { return await fetch(path, { ...(init || {}), signal }) } catch (e) { if (!fired && ext && ext.aborted) throw new Error(ABORT_HINT) throw e } finally { clearTimeout(timer) } } async function backendJson(port: number, path: string, timeoutMs = 20000, init?: any): Promise { const r = await withTimeout(base(port) + path, init, timeoutMs) const text = await r.text() try { return JSON.parse(text) } catch (e) { return { ok: false, raw: text.slice(0, 500) } } ```
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[src/index.ts:1499-1515](https://github.com/sixtysevenlf/dsh-blender-plugin/blob/f9f115f86b3c40fbe8d3dba811283acf71df03f9/src/index.ts#L1499-L1515) Skill、配置及自动后端启动。

      "path": "README.md",
      "content": "# DSH × Blender

[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

DSH × Blender connects DeepSeek Harness to Blender so an agent can build, inspect, validate, and export 3D scenes in a real Blender session. The normal workflow is GUI-first: start Blender, connect the addon, and let the agent look, change, and verify. When no GUI is available, a persistent headless session provides the same interactive loop, including frames.

## Contents

- [Features](#features)
- [Quick start](#quick-start)
- [Tools](#tools)
- [Documentation](#documentation)
- [Troubleshooting](#troubleshooting)
- [Development](#development)
- [Support](#support)
- [License](#license)

## Features

- **GUI-first interactive modeling.** The agent works against the Blender session you are looking at. It can inspect the scene, run Python in a persistent kernel, take a viewport or custom-angle frame, and iterate one step at a time.
- **Headless fallback with visual feedback.** If Blender has no GUI, start a persistent worker and the agent can still execute code and get Workbench frames. This is a fallback path, not the default; it exists so the agent is never blind.
- **Reference-image measurement.** Measure silhouettes, holes, symmetry, readable features, and scale from a reference image before modeling. If no scale is known, the tools return pixel units instead of inventing millimeters.
- **Assembly audit and repair.** Validate an assembly manifest, classify clashes, hidden overlaps, contacts, gaps, floating parts, and contained parts, apply safe repairs, gate the result, and export GLB, FBX, or OBJ with a manifest and merge ledger.
- **Blockout and video-reference packs.** Build low-poly blockouts from declarative parts, render orthographic and perspective reference views, and produce a turntable MP4 for video models such as Seedance.
- **Visual acceptance and delivery gates.** Compare renders against references from the same camera, report defects with crops and measurements, run defect-injection evaluation, and block delivery when the gate is not pass.
- **Automation and long jobs.** Run one-shot headless scripts, long background jobs, parameter searches, and batch validation without occupying the GUI.
- **Native selection.** Select objects or collections in Blender and send them into the current DSH draft.
- **Works in dsh-TUI too.** In dsh-TUI, a Blender selection is attached to your next message as a context chip; the footer shows the Blender channel state (connected / AI paused / rendering / jobs); `@` mentions scene objects, materials, and collections; and `/blender status|doctor|jobs` checks the channel without going through the model. Each part needs the matching dsh-TUI seam and stays off when the seam is missing.

## Quick start

**Before anything else: install the bundled addon first.** Use only the addon shipped in this repository: **addon/dsh_blender_bridge.py**. Do not install MCP for Blender or any other Blender addon. Install and enable this addon in Blender before the other steps. If the installation below does not work, first check that this exact addon is installed, enabled, and connected.

### Requirements

- DSH (DeepSeek Harness) installed and working.
- Node.js 20 or newer for the backend.
- Blender 4.x or 5.x. GUI mode requires the bundled addon (install it first); headless mode only needs the Blender executable.
- Optional: a DSH source checkout if you want to rebuild the plugin.

### Option A: ask an AI agent

Copy this prompt into an agent that can run commands:

    First install and enable the bundled addon addon/dsh_blender_bridge.py
    from this repository; do not use MCP for Blender or any other addon.
    Then install the DSH × Blender plugin from
    https://github.com/sixtysevenlf/dsh-blender-plugin
    for my DSH profile. Read docs/AI-安装提示词.md first, follow it exactly,
    and finish with the acceptance check: doctor must return kind=ok for the
    GUI route, or worker start + see must return a frame for the headless-only route.
    Do not skip the check and do not claim success without it.

Fetch the full install prompt locally:

    curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sixtysevenlf/dsh-blender-plugin/main/docs/AI-安装提示词.md -o AI-安装提示词.md

Install the standalone modeling skill (only needed for hosts that do not load the plugin; DSH gets it bundled):

    curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sixtysevenlf/dsh-blender-plugin/main/skills/blender-modeling/install.sh | bash

### Option B: manual setup

1. **Install the bundled addon first.**

   Download **addon/dsh_blender_bridge.py** from the addon/ folder of this repository. In Blender, open Edit > Preferences > Add-ons > Install, select that file, enable DSH Blender Bridge, open the N panel in the 3D view, and click Connect. The addon listens on 127.0.0.1:9876.

   Use only this addon. Disable MCP for Blender or any other Blender addon before continuing. If the rest of the installation does not work, check this step first.

2. Clone the repository and, if needed, build it. The repository commits the built lib directory, so a normal clone is ready to use.

        git clone https://github.com/sixtysevenlf/dsh-blender-plugin.git
        cd dsh-blender-plugin
        # Optional: only after changing src/
        DSH_CHECKOUT=/path/to/dsh-harness bash scripts/build.sh

3. Add the package to your DSH profile as a bundle. Link the checkout into the profile, then add the dependency and bundle entry to the profile package.json.

        ln -s /absolute/path/to/dsh-blender-plugin <profile>/node_modules/@dsh-external/dsh-blender-plugin

    Profile package.json:

        {
          "dependencies": {
            "@dsh-external/dsh-blender-plugin": "link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-blender-plugin"
          },
          "dsh": {
            "profile": {
              "bundles": ["@dsh-external/dsh-blender-plugin"]
            }
          }
        }

    Validate the profile and restart DSH:

        dsh --profile <profile> --dump-config

4. Verify the installation.

    GUI route:

        curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:9877/health
        curl -sS http://127.0.0.1:9877/doctor

    The only acceptance criterion for the GUI route is doctor returning kind equal to ok. If it does not, the plugin is not installed correctly.

    After DSH restarts, you can also use blender_viewport with op equal to launch. It starts Blender, enables the addon, and connects automatically.

    Headless-only route (no addon):

        blender_rt_worker(op="start", name="smoke")
        blender_rt_worker(op="see", name="smoke")

    A returned frame means the headless fallback is working. The doctor bpy round-trip is expected to be unreachable in this mode.

## Tools

The plugin exposes 15 tools. All planning, audit, assembly, export, and evaluation operations live under blender_rt_plan, so the tool list stays small.

### Interaction and control

| Tool | What it gives you |
|---|---|
| blender_rt_see | A frame of the current GUI viewport or a custom camera angle. |
| blender_rt_do | Runs Python in Blender with a persistent kernel; can return a frame with the result. |
| blender_rt_watch | Samples a time window or frame range and reports whether the image changed. |
| blender_rt_worker | A persistent headless session for interactive work when no GUI is available. |

### Planning and operations

| Tool | What it gives you |
|---|---|
| blender_rt_plan | The capability catalog and the execution surface for modeling, audit, assembly, delivery, and evaluation operations. Start here when you are unsure which operation to use. |
| blender_viewport | Channel health, doctor, launch, and write-lease operations for coordinating multiple sessions. |

### Automation and jobs

| Tool | What it gives you |
|---|---|
| blender_rt_headless | Runs a standalone Blender background process for batch work, validation, or rendering. |
| blender_rt_job | Starts long work in the background and collects the result by job id; a timeout does not lose the result. |
| blender_rt_loop | Runs a parameter search loop inside Blender and returns the best candidates. |

### Scene utilities

| Tool | What it gives you |
|---|---|
| blender_rt_txn | File-level snapshots and object-level marks for rollback. |
| blender_rt_preset | Saves, lists, applies, and exports reusable parameter presets. |
| blender_rt_perf | Diagnoses and applies render performance settings. |
| blender_rt_opt | Finds safe object merges to reduce scene overhead. |

### Addon access

| Tool | What it gives you |
|---|---|
| blender_rt_cmd | Calls any addon command directly. |
| blender_rt_commands | Lists available addon commands and integration states. |

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | What to do |
|---|---|
| doctor does not return kind equal to ok | Check that Blender is running and the addon is connected. For the GUI route this is the only valid acceptance check. |
| No GUI is available | Use the persistent worker fallback: start a worker, then run code and request a frame. |
| Another session is writing to the same scene | Take the write lease with blender_viewport, or use separate headless workers for parallel work. |
| An old MCP for Blender addon is installed | Disable it and install the bundled DSH Blender Bridge addon instead. |
| Images are generated but not attached | Update to the latest build; the Windows path fix is included. If it persists, open the returned path directly. |
| Followed the steps and it still does not work | Check the bundled addon first: only addon/dsh_blender_bridge.py is supported, and it must be enabled and connected. |

## Development

- Run the offline test suite: npm test
- Rebuild after changing src: DSH_CHECKOUT=/path/to/dsh-harness bash scripts/build.sh
- Bundled skill source: skills/blender-modeling/

## Support

If this project is useful to you, you can support its development on Afdian (爱发电): <https://afdian.com/a/sixtysevenlf>

const EXEC_CTX = new AsyncLocalStorage<any>()

function execSignal(): AbortSignal | undefined {
  const s = EXEC_CTX.getStore()

/**
 * v0.9.4（P0 返回通道）：**工具返回值统一消毒**，保证过得了宿主的 lossless-JSON 门。
 *
 * 背景（外部反馈 2026-09-25《M1A1 分件建模》）：宿主用 dsh-util-values 的 walkJsonValue 校验
 * 每个工具的返回值，规则**比 JSON.stringify 严格得多**，以下一律判
 * `tool "…" returned invalid output: value is not lossless JSON` 并把整条工具通道打死：
 *   - 自有可枚举键的值为 undefined（stringify 会丢键 → 肉眼看不出来）
 *   - NaN / ±Infinity（stringify 变 null）· -0（stringify 变 0，符号丢失）
 *   - Date / Map / Set / 类实例 / 函数 / Symbol / 循环引用 / 带符号或非枚举键的对象
 * 实测后果：v0.9.3 的 envelope 里一个 `promoted: undefined` 让
 * blender_rt_headless **每次都失败**（任务其实跑完了、结果也在磁盘上，只是回执被拒），
 * rt_job 的 status/collect/wait 同病 —— 即"任务能交出去但收不回来"。
 *
 * 消毒口径（**不静默**：每一处改动都记进 fixes，回执文本里点名）：
 *   undefined → 丢键（数组元素 → null，长度不塌）· 非有限数 → null · -0 → 0
 *   bigint → number（超安全整数则 string）· Date → ISO 字符串 · Map/Set → 数组
 *   类实例 → 取自有可枚举属性 · 二进制视图 → {bytes:N} · 循环 → '[Circular]'
 */
function losslessSanitize(root: any): { value: any; fixes: string[] } {
  const fixes: string[] = []
  const seen = new Set<any>()
  const walk = (v: any, at: string): any => {
    if (v === null) return null
    const t = typeof v
    if (t === 'string' || t === 'boolean') return v
    if (t === 'number') {
      if (!Number.isFinite(v)) { fixes.push(at + '=' + String(v) + '→null'); return null }
      if (Object.is(v, -0)) { fixes.push(at + '=-0→0'); return 0 }
      return v
    }
    if (t === 'undefined') { fixes.push(at + '=undefined→丢弃'); return undefined }
    if (t === 'bigint') {
      const n = Number(v)
      fixes.push(at + '=bigint→' + (Number.isSafeInteger(n) ? 'number' : 'string'))
      return Number.isSafeInteger(n) ? n : String(v)
    }
    if (t === 'function' || t === 'symbol') { fixes.push(at + '=' + t + '→丢弃'); return undefined }
    if (seen.has(v)) { fixes.push(at + '=循环引用→[Circular]'); return '[Circular]' }
    seen.add(v)
    let out: any
    if (Array.isArray(v)) {
      out = []
      for (let i = 0; i < v.length; i++) {
        const w = walk(v[i], at + '[' + String(i) + ']')
        out.push(w === undefined ? null : w)          // 数组元素不能用 undefined
      }
    } else if (v instanceof Date) {
      const ms = v.getTime()
      fixes.push(at + '=Date→ISO')
      out = Number.isFinite(ms) ? v.toISOString() : null
    } else if (v instanceof Map) {
      fixes.push(at + '=Map→数组')
      out = Array.from(v.entries()).map((e: any, i: number) => walk(e, at + '<map' + String(i) + '>'))
    } else if (v instanceof Set) {
      fixes.push(at + '=Set→数组')
      out = Array.from(v.values()).map((e: any, i: number) => walk(e, at + '<set' + String(i) + '>'))
    } else if (ArrayBuffer.isView(v) || v instanceof ArrayBuffer) {
      const n = (v as any).byteLength
      fixes.push(at + '=二进制(' + String(n) + 'B)→{bytes}（要回传给模型请走 attachments/saveImage）')
      out = { bytes: n, why: 'binary-not-json' }
    } else if (typeof v.toJSON === 'function' && !isPlainObjectLike(v)) {
      // 宿主没定义 toJSON 语义，但它至少比类实例更可能给出 JSON 形状；失败就退回自有键
      try { return walk(v.toJSON(), at + '<toJSON>') } catch (e) { /* 退回自有可枚举键 */ }
      // eslint-disable-next-line no-fallthrough
      out = {}
      for (const k of Object.keys(v)) {
        const w = walk(v[k], at + '.' + k)
        if (w !== undefined) out[k] = w
      }
    } else {
      out = {}
      for (const k of Object.keys(v)) {
        const w = walk(v[k], at + '.' + k)
        if (w !== undefined) out[k] = w      // 丢键（宿主拒收 undefined 值）
      }
    }
    seen.delete(v)                            // DAG 共享（非循环）可以重复出现
    return out
  }
  const value = walk(root, 'value')
  return { value: value === undefined ? null : value, fixes: fixes }
}
/** 普通对象/数组判定（用于决定是否走 toJSON 分支） */
function isPlainObjectLike(v: any): boolean {
  if (Array.isArray(v)) return true
  const proto = Object.getPrototypeOf(v)
  return proto === Object.prototype || proto === null
}

const vTool = (spec: any): any => defineTool({
  ...spec,
  // v2.6.1：工具卡片（只管宿主 UI 怎么显示，不改模型侧回执；见 cardPresenters）
  ...cardPresenters(spec),
  description: '[v' + PLUGIN_VERSION + '] ' + String((spec && spec.description) || ''),
  // v0.9.4（P0 返回通道）：所有工具**唯一出口**都过一遍 losslessSanitize ——
  // 一个字段写错（NaN / undefined / -0）不该让整条工具通道变成不可用。
  execute: async (args: any, exec: any) => {
    const raw = await EXEC_CTX.run(exec || {}, () => (spec.execute as any)(args, exec))
    const { value, fixes } = losslessSanitize(raw)
    if (fixes.length) {
      const note = '⚠️ 回执已消毒 ' + String(fixes.length) + ' 处非 lossless-JSON 值（宿主门会拒收 undefined/NaN/Infinity/-0）：'
        + fixes.slice(0, 6).join(' · ') + (fixes.length > 6 ? ' …等' : '')
      try {
        if (value && typeof value === 'object' && typeof value.text === 'string') value.text += String.fromCharCode(10) + note
        else if (value && typeof value === 'object') value.__losslessNote = note
        console.warn('[dsh-blender] ' + note)
      } catch (e) { /* 提示失败不影响返回 */ }
    }
    return value

})
// 只为类型：`import type` 编译后被完全擦除，运行期不会要求这个包名存在
// （运行期由下面的**双通道**运行时解析负责）。
import type zt from '@deepseek-ai/schemastery'
/**
 * schemastery 的包名在不同 DSH 版本间是**有 scope / 无 scope 两种形态**（`schemastery` ↔
 * `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`；cordis 同理），静态 import 无法条件化，只能运行期解析。
 *
 * v1.0.1+S11（issue #10 修复）—— 解析顺序与失败语义都改了：
 *   ① **顺序**：ESM `await import()` 优先，失败再退回 `createRequire`。
 *      旧版只走 createRequire：在"宿主只提供带 scope 的名字"的 profile 里，该 require 在
 *      多插件共存时的 DSH module-resolution 拦截下解析失败（现场 3/3 复现，见 issue #10 的
 *      bundle 二分表），而 ESM loader 正是宿主自己走的那条路 —— 所以先试它。
 *   ② **失败语义**：顶层不再 `throw`。旧版在模块载入期抛错 ⇒ 宿主只回一句 `failed to import`
 *      （真因被吞）、entry 的 fiber 始终 undefined ⇒ **15 个工具整体消失、后端也不起**，
 *      且现象与真因不在同一层，极难定位。现在改为**降级加载**：注册一个只回报原因的占位工具
 *      （见下面 DEGRADED 分支），其余工具不注册，但报错可读、插件不会消失。
 *   ③ **诊断**：走了哪条通道、试过哪些名字，进 __internals.schemaResolve，并在 op=status /
 *      op=doctor 里可见（这类"静默整体消失"必须留下可读的现场）。
 */
const SM_NAMES: string[] = ['@deepseek-ai/schemastery', 'schemastery']
const schemaResolve: { z?: typeof zt; via?: string; error?: string; tried: string[] } = { tried: [] }
/** 只取错误的首行 + 截断：诊断要能一行说完，不要把整个 stack 塞进状态输出 */
const smErrLine = (e: any): string => String((e && e.code) || (e && e.message) || e).split('\n')[0].slice(0, 120)
/** 形态判定：能拿到带 `.object()` 的那一层才算可用（拿不到就是不认，不赌） */
const smPick = (m: any): any => {
  for (const c of [m && m.default, m]) if (c && typeof c.object === 'function') return c
  return null
}
for (const id of SM_NAMES) {
  try {
    const m: any = await import(/* webpackIgnore: true */ id)
    const hit = smPick(m)
    if (hit) { schemaResolve.z = hit; schemaResolve.via = 'esm:' + id; break }
    schemaResolve.tried.push(id + '(esm:no-object)')
  } catch (e) { schemaResolve.tried.push(id + '(esm:' + smErrLine(e) + ')') }
}
if (!schemaResolve.z) {
  try {
    const req = createRequire(import.meta.url)
    for (const id of SM_NAMES) {
      try {
        const m: any = req(id)
        const hit = smPick(m)
        if (hit) { schemaResolve.z = hit; schemaResolve.via = 'cjs:' + id; break }
        schemaResolve.tried.push(id + '(cjs:no-object)')
      } catch (e) { schemaResolve.tried.push(id + '(cjs:' + smErrLine(e) + ')') }
    }
  } catch (e) { schemaResolve.tried.push('createRequire(' + smErrLine(e) + ')') }
}
if (!schemaResolve.z) {
  schemaResolve.error = 'schemastery 解析失败，已尝试：' + schemaResolve.tried.join(' / ')
    + '。宿主需提供 schemastery —— 有 scope 的 @deepseek-ai/schemastery 或无 scope 的 schemastery 任一即可。'
  console.error('[dsh-blender] ' + schemaResolve.error
    + '（降级加载：只注册一个诊断占位工具，不会再出现"15 个工具整体消失且真因被吞"）')
}
const z: any = schemaResolve.z

export const name = '@dsh-external/dsh-blender-plugin'

// 后端与 Blender 侧模块都放在插件包的 runtime/ 下 → 整个包可搬到任意目录（WSL 或 Windows）

/**
 * 端口解析（与 runtime/config.mjs 同一套来源，避免两处配置漂移）：
 *   插件配置 port → DSH_BLENDER_HTTP_PORT → $DSH_BLENDER_CONFIG → <包根>/dsh-blender.config.json
 *   → ~/.dsh/dsh-blender.config.json → 9877
 */
function resolveHttpPort(): number {
  const env = Number(process.env.DSH_BLENDER_HTTP_PORT)
  if (Number.isFinite(env) && env > 0) return env
  const cands = [
    process.env.DSH_BLENDER_CONFIG,
    path.join(HERE, '..', 'dsh-blender.config.json'),
    path.join(os.homedir(), '.dsh', 'dsh-blender.config.json'),
  ].filter(Boolean) as string[]
  for (const p of cands) {
    try {
      const j = JSON.parse(readFileSync(p, 'utf8'))
      const n = Number(j && j.httpPort)
      if (Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0) return n
    } catch (e) { /* 没这个文件或不是 JSON：跳过 */ }
  }
  return 9877
}
/** 后端未就绪时的统一提示（不假设任何本机路径） */
const BACKEND_HINT = '先确认 Blender 在运行且本仓 addon（DSH Blender Bridge v1.10+）已 Connect；然后 blender_viewport op=start 拉起后端。'
  + '端口/工作目录/blender.exe 可用 DSH_BLENDER_* 环境变量或包根 dsh-blender.config.json 配置（见 docs/配置参考.md）。'

let child: any = null
/** 用户用 op=stop 显式停过 → 看护不再自动拉起（op=start 解除） */
let paused = false

function base(port: number): string {
  return 'http://' + HOSTNAME + ':' + String(port)
}
const sleep = (ms: number) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms))

import { probeHttp, decideStart, waitHttp } from '../runtime/backend_probe.mjs'
import { detectFileAlias } from '../runtime/file_guard.mjs'

async function probe(port: number, timeoutMs = 1500): Promise<boolean> {
  const ac = new AbortController()
  const timer = setTimeout(() => ac.abort(), timeoutMs)
  try {
    const r = await fetch(base(port) + '/health', { signal: ac.signal })
    return r.ok
  } catch (e) {
    return false
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(timer)
  }
}

async function ensureBackend(port: number): Promise<boolean> {
  if (await probe(port)) return true
  if (paused) return false
  try { await startBackend(port) } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
  for (let i = 0; i < 25; i++) {
    if (await probe(port)) return true
    await sleep(300)
  }
  return false
}

/** 子进程是否真的还活着：被信号杀掉时 exitCode 仍为 null、只有 signalCode 有值 */
function childAlive(): boolean {
  return !!(child && child.exitCode === null && child.signalCode === null && child.pid)
}

function spawnChild(port: number): string {
  child = spawn(process.execPath, [SERVER_PATH, '--port', String(port)], { stdio: 'ignore', detached: true })
  child.unref()
  return 'spawned pid=' + String(child.pid)
}

/**
 * S7 修复：**探端口优先**，不再信陈旧句柄/pidfile。
 * 现场 bug：句柄还在（childAlive）但端口根本没监听时，旧实现回 'already-spawned'，
 * 用户拿到一个打不通的后端；反过来，真起来了却因为等待窗口太短回 '启动失败'。
 * 现在：端口能服务 ⇒ already-running；端口不通但句柄在 ⇒ 判为陈旧句柄，SIGTERM 后重拉。
 */
async function startBackend(port: number): Promise<string> {
  const url = base(port) + '/health'
  const portUp = await probeHttp(url, 800)
  const decision = decideStart({ portUp, childAlive: childAlive() })
  if (decision === 'already-running') return 'already-running'
  if (decision === 'stale-handle') {
    const stalePid = child && child.pid
    try { if (stalePid) process.kill(stalePid, 'SIGTERM') } catch (e) { /* 已经没了 */ }
    child = null
    return 'stale-handle(pid=' + String(stalePid) + ')->' + spawnChild(port)
  }
  return spawnChild(port)
}

/**
 * 按 /proc 扫出"本插件历史代次拉起的后端"，按 signal 停掉（默认 SIGTERM）。
 * 热重载会丢掉 child 句柄（上一代 fiber 持有），只靠句柄停不掉残留进程 —— 这是兜底。
 * v1.0.1+S10：新增 signal 参数（事件循环被同步操作占死的进程只认 SIGKILL）。
 */
function killBackendByCmd(port: number, signal: NodeJS.Signals = 'SIGTERM'): string[] {
  const killed: string[] = []
  const wantPort = String(port)
  // macOS 支持：把「列进程」抽成一条可移植的候选链 —— /proc 只有 Linux 有，
  // macOS 没有；原先只读 /proc，在 mac 上静默返回 []（热重载后残留后端停不掉）。
  const rows: Array<{ pid: number; toks: string[] }> = []
  let listed = false
  // ① Linux：直接读 /proc（最准，无外部依赖）
  try {
    for (const d of readdirSync('/proc')) {
      if (!/^[0-9]+$/.test(d)) continue
      if (Number(d) === process.pid) continue
      try {
        const toks = readFileSync('/proc/' + d + '/cmdline', 'utf8').split('\u0000').filter(Boolean)
        rows.push({ pid: Number(d), toks })
      } catch (e) { /* 进程可能已退出 */ }
    }
    listed = true
  } catch (e) { /* 无 /proc（macOS/Windows）→ 走 ② */ }
  // ② macOS / 通用 POSIX：ps 输出 pid + 完整命令行
  if (!listed) {
    try {
      for (const line of execFileSync('ps', ['-ax', '-o', 'pid=,command='], { encoding: 'utf8', timeout: 5000 }).split('\n')) {
        const m = /^\s*(\d+)\s+(.*)$/.exec(line)
        if (!m) continue
        const pid = Number(m[1])
        if (pid === process.pid) continue
        rows.push({ pid, toks: m[2].trim().split(/\s+/) })
      }
    } catch (e) { /* ps 不可用则不兜底 */ }
  }
  for (const r of rows) {
    // ★ v1.0.1+S10（自伤修复）：按 **argv token** 精确匹配，绝不拿整条 cmdline 做子串匹配 ——
    //   调用方的 `bash -c "... node runtime/server.mjs --port 9877 ..."` 命令行同样含这两个串，
    //   子串匹配会把调用方自己的 shell 一起 SIGKILL 掉（2026-09-29 实测踩到，A/B 当场抓出）。
    let isServer = false
    let portOk = false
    let isShell = false
    for (let i = 0; i < r.toks.length; i++) {
      if (i === 0 && /(^|\/)(bash|sh|zsh|dash|fish|bwrap)$/.test(r.toks[i])) isShell = true
      if (i >= 1 && /(^|\/)server\.mjs$/.test(r.toks[i])) isServer = true     // 必须是独立 argv 且以 server.mjs 结尾
      if (r.toks[i] === '--port' && r.toks[i + 1] === wantPort) portOk = true
    }
    if (isServer && portOk && !isShell) {
      try { process.kill(r.pid, signal); killed.push(String(r.pid)) } catch (e) { /* 已退出 */ }
    }
  }
  return killed
}

/** 宿主取消（exec.signal abort）时的统一措辞：只说"等待被取消"，不谎称任务失败 */
const ABORT_HINT = '宿主取消了本次等待（exec.signal 已 abort：用户打断或 per-tool 截止）。'
  + '服务端任务可能仍在跑 —— 长任务请用 blender_rt_job 并按 runId 回收；'
  + '本插件的内部超时通常先于宿主截止触发，正常情况看到的是上面这类可读错误。'

/**
 * v0.9.2：合并「本插件内部超时」与「宿主 exec.signal」。
 * 两条都只影响**等待**：服务端已开始的 Blender 侧任务照旧跑完（headless/job 既有语义
 * = 客户端断连 ≠ 任务失败，按 runId 回收）。
 */
async function withTimeout(path: string, init: any, timeoutMs: number): Promise<Response> {
  const ac = new AbortController()
  const ext = execSignal()
  let fired = false
  const timer = setTimeout(() => { fired = true; ac.abort() }, timeoutMs)
  const signal = ext ? AbortSignal.any([ext, ac.signal]) : ac.signal
  try {
    return await fetch(path, { ...(init || {}), signal })
  } catch (e) {
    if (!fired && ext && ext.aborted) throw new Error(ABORT_HINT)
    throw e
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(timer)
  }
}

async function backendJson(port: number, path: string, timeoutMs = 20000, init?: any): Promise<any> {
  const r = await withTimeout(base(port) + path, init, timeoutMs)
  const text = await r.text()
  try { return JSON.parse(text) } catch (e) { return { ok: false, raw: text.slice(0, 500) } }
}

/** 本会话在写通道上的身份（租约 holder）；跨会话共用同一个后端时用它区分 */
const HOLDER = process.env.DSH_BLENDER_HOLDER || ('plugin-pid-' + String(process.pid))

/**
 * 解析后端响应（v0.8.9 修）：后端有两种形态 ——
 *   ① 普通路由：整段就是一个 JSON；
 *   ② 流式路由（/headless /worker /txn /preset）：NDJSON，**每 15 s 先写一行** {"heartbeat":true,...}，最后一行才是结果。
 * 旧实现整段 JSON.parse，于是任何 **超过 15 s** 的调用都会抛 Extra data → 调用方只看到 exit=undefined（子进程其实跑完了）。
 * 现在：解析失败就按行往前找最后一条非心跳 JSON；同时把心跳条数记进 __heartbeats 供工具层提示。
 */
function parseBackendBody(text: string): any {
  const t = String(text == null ? '' : text)
  try {
    const o = JSON.parse(t)
    if (o && typeof o === 'object') return o
  } catch (e) { /* 流式响应，往下走 */ }
  const lines = t.split('\n').map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean)
  let last: any = null
  let beats = 0
  for (let i = lines.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    let o: any = null
    try { o = JSON.parse(lines[i]) } catch (e) { continue }
    if (!o || typeof o !== 'object') continue
    if (o.heartbeat === true) continue
    last = o
    break
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
    try { const o = JSON.parse(lines[i]); if (o && o.heartbeat === true) beats++ } catch (e) { /* 非 JSON 行 */ }
  }
  if (last) { last.__heartbeats = beats; last.__streamLines = lines.length; return last }
  return { ok: false, raw: t.slice(-500), streamLines: lines.length, parseError: 'no JSON line found' }
}

/**
 * 写操作统一走它：自动带 holder（租约门禁用），并保留 HTTP 状态码便于识别 409。
 *
 * v0.9.3（D1，关键）：**计时器必须活到 body 读完**。
 * 旧版是 withTimeout(fetch) → fetch 在**收到响应头**时就 resolve（流式路由 /headless 立刻发头 + 每 15 s 心跳），
 * 于是超时预算只覆盖「等响应头」，随后的 r.text() 无限期等下去 —— 客户端等待窗口形同虚设，
 * 外层 run_code 的 deadline 一到就整段丢结果（正是 D1 报的现象）。
 * 现在把 text() 也放进同一个 AbortController：到点 abort → fetch / body 读取一起抛 AbortError。
 */
async function backendPost(port: number, path: string, body: any, timeoutMs = 60000): Promise<any> {
  const ac = new AbortController()
  const ext = execSignal()
  let fired = false
  const timer = setTimeout(() => { fired = true; ac.abort() }, timeoutMs)
  const signal = ext ? AbortSignal.any([ext, ac.signal]) : ac.signal
  try {
    const r = await fetch(base(port) + path, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ ...(body || {}), holder: HOLDER }),
      signal,
    })
    const text = await r.text()
    const j: any = parseBackendBody(text)
    j.__status = r.status
    return j
  } catch (e) {
    if (!fired && ext && ext.aborted) throw new Error(ABORT_HINT)
    throw e
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(timer)
  }
}

/** v0.9.1：工具入参容错 —— harness 的 `type:"json"` 有时把对象给成**字符串**（实测同一会话里两种形态都出现过），
 *  旧写法 `typeof x === 'object'` 会静默丢参（表现为"参数没生效却 ok:true"，非常难查）。 */
function jsonPayload(v: any): any {
  if (v === undefined || v === null || v === '') return {}
  if (typeof v === 'string') {
    try { const p = JSON.parse(v); return (p && typeof p === 'object' && !Array.isArray(p)) ? p : {} } catch (e) { return {} }
  }
  if (typeof v === 'object' && !Array.isArray(v)) return { ...v }
  return {}
}

/** 把 "‑‑flag \"a b\" c" 这样的字符串切成 argv（引号成对时不当分隔符；v0.8.9 修 headless 的 args 引号问题）
 *  v0.9.1：数组直接透传（旧版 `String([...])` 会变成 "[delta]" 这种带方括号的单个 token） */
function splitArgs(s: any): string[] {
  if (Array.isArray(s)) return s.map((x) => String(x))
  const str = String(s == null ? '' : s)
  const out: string[] = []
  let cur = ''
  let q: string | null = null
  for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) {
    const c = str[i]
    if (q) { if (c === q) q = null; else cur += c; continue }
    if (c === '"' || c === "'") { q = c; continue }
    if (/\s/.test(c)) { if (cur) { out.push(cur); cur = '' } continue }
    cur += c
  }
  if (cur) out.push(cur)
  return out
}

/** 409 leased → 给模型一句能照着做的话（而不是丢一段 JSON） */
function leasedText(r: any): string | undefined {
  if (!r || r.error !== 'leased') return undefined
  return '写通道被别的会话占用（holder=' + String(r.holder) + '，剩余 ' + String(Math.round(Number(r.expiresInMs || 0) / 1000)) + 's）。'
    + String(r.hint || '') + '；要强抢：blender_viewport op=lease force=true'
}

/** 拉一帧 PNG 字节（含耗时）；full=true 走 screenshot_area（整窗口/区域） */
async function fetchFrame(port: number, size: number, full = false, area = 0): Promise<any> {
  const t0 = Date.now()
  const url = base(port) + '/frame.png?' + (full ? ('full=1&area=' + String(area)) : ('size=' + String(size)))
  const r = await withTimeout(url, {}, 60000)
  if (!r.ok) throw new Error('frame http ' + String(r.status))
  const buf = new Uint8Array(await r.arrayBuffer())
  return { png: buf, ms: Date.now() - t0, hash: createHash('md5').update(buf).digest('hex').slice(0, 8) }
}

/** 自定义视角出图：POST /view（view.py）——不动物体、不动用户视口 */
async function fetchView(port: number, spec: any, timeoutMs = 180000): Promise<any> {
  const t0 = Date.now()
  const r = await withTimeout(base(port) + '/view', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify(spec || {}),
  }, timeoutMs)
  if (!r.ok) {
    const text = await r.text()
    let j: any = null
    try { j = JSON.parse(text) } catch (e) { j = null }
    throw new Error('view http ' + String(r.status) + ' · ' + String((j && j.error) || text.slice(0, 300)))
  }
  let meta: any = null
  try {
    const rawHdr = String(r.headers.get('x-dsh-view') || 'null')
    // v0.9.1：头值 URL 编码（非 ASCII 不能进头）—— 老后端是裸 JSON，两种都兼容
    const txt = rawHdr.indexOf('%7B') === 0 ? decodeURIComponent(rawHdr) : rawHdr
    meta = JSON.parse(txt)
  } catch (e) { meta = null }
  const buf = new Uint8Array(await r.arrayBuffer())
  return { png: buf, ms: Date.now() - t0, meta: meta, hash: createHash('md5').update(buf).digest('hex').slice(0, 8) }
}

function numTriple(v: any): number[] | undefined {
  if (v === undefined || v === null || v === '') return undefined
  if (Array.isArray(v)) return v.map((x) => Number(x))
  return String(v).split(/[,\s]+/).filter(Boolean).map((x) => Number(x))
}

/**
 * v0.9.4（P0-2）帧去重：**同一画面不重复附图**。
 *
 * 为什么：hash 已经是 PNG 字节的 md5 前 8 位（fetchFrame / fetchView 都算好了），
 * 而重复附图只烧**模型侧视觉 token** —— 实测同一画面连发 5 次 hash 全等
 * （`038c7439`）、单帧 116,870 B。hash 相等 ⇒ 像素逐字节相同 ⇒ 跳过附件**不丢任何信息**。
 * 要强行重发（例如想再看一眼）传 `force:true`。
 *
 * 缓存按"通道"分键：默认视口帧 / 自定义视角（按视角签名）/ rt_do 的 see，互不干扰。
 */
const FRAME_CACHE = new Map<string, { hash: string; firstAt: number; repeats: number }>()

/** 纯决策：命中 ⇒ dup=true 且计数 +1；未命中 ⇒ 记下新 hash。force=true 一律当未命中处理并重置。 */
export function frameDedupe(key: string, hash: string, force = false): { dup: boolean; repeats: number; firstAt: number } {
  const k = String(key || 'default')
  const h = String(hash || '')
  const cur = FRAME_CACHE.get(k)
  if (!force && cur && h && cur.hash === h) {
    cur.repeats += 1
    return { dup: true, repeats: cur.repeats, firstAt: cur.firstAt }
  }
  const firstAt = Date.now()
  FRAME_CACHE.set(k, { hash: h, firstAt, repeats: 0 })
  if (FRAME_CACHE.size > 32) {   // 键很少（几种通道），加个硬上限防意外增长
    const oldest = FRAME_CACHE.keys().next().value
    if (oldest !== undefined && oldest !== k) FRAME_CACHE.delete(oldest)
  }
  return { dup: false, repeats: 0, firstAt }
}

/** 测试用：清空去重缓存 */
export function resetFrameCache(): void { FRAME_CACHE.clear() }

/** 去重命中时统一的措辞（写清"相同、未附图、怎么要回来"，避免 agent 误以为看过图） */
function dedupeNote(repeats: number): string {
  return ' · **与上一张完全相同**（第 ' + String(repeats + 1) + ' 次）⇒ 未重复附图；要重发传 force:true'
}

/** PNG → durable attachment（v0.9.2 起失败**不再静默**：返回 {ref} 或 {why}，由调用方写进工具文本） */
async function toAttachment(ctx: any, data: Uint8Array, name: string): Promise<{ ref?: any; why?: string }> {
  try {
    const attachments = ctx.get('attachments')
    if (!attachments) return { why: '宿主没有 attachments 服务（ctx.get("attachments") 为空）' }
    const mediaTypes: string[] = attachments.imageLimits?.mediaTypes ?? []
    if (!mediaTypes.includes('image/png')) return { why: '宿主 imageLimits.mediaTypes 不含 image/png（' + JSON.stringify(mediaTypes) + '）' }
    const ref = await attachments.saveImage({ data, mediaType: 'image/png', name })
    return {
      ref: {
        attachmentId: ref.attachmentId,
        mediaType: ref.mediaType,
        bytes: ref.bytes,
        width: ref.width,
        height: ref.height,
        ...(ref.name === undefined ? {} : { name: ref.name }),
      },
    }
  } catch (e) {
    return { why: 'saveImage 失败：' + String((e && e.message) || e) }
  }
}

/** Windows / UNC 路径 → WSL 路径（本机 DSH 在 WSL 里跑；Windows 宿主则原样返回）。 */
function toWslPath(p: any): string {
  const s = String(p == null ? '' : p)
  if (!s) return s
  // Windows 宿主：D:\... 本来就是本机可用路径，转成 /mnt/d/... 反而读不到（Windows 上无此挂载）。
  if (process.platform === 'win32') return s
  if (/^[A-Za-z]:[\\/]/.test(s)) return '/mnt/' + s[0].toLowerCase() + s.slice(2).replace(/\\/g, '/')
  const m = s.match(/^\\\\wsl\.localhost\\[^\\]+\\(.*)$/i)
  if (m) return '/' + String(m[1]).replace(/\\/g, '/')
  return s
}
/** 读本地 PNG（失败返回 null；调用方负责把 why 写进文本，不静默） */
function readLocalPng(p: any): Uint8Array | null {
  const s = String(p == null ? '' : p)
  if (!s) return null
  const converted = toWslPath(s)
  const candidates = converted === s ? [s] : [converted, s]
  for (const candidate of candidates) {
    try { return readFileSync(candidate) } catch (e) { /* try next form */ }
  }
  return null
}
/** 批量附图：≤max 张；返回已附的 attachment 与失败清单（路径/原因） */
async function attachPaths(ctx: any, paths: any[], tag: string, max = 2): Promise<{ images: any[]; used: string[]; failed: string[] }> {
  const images: any[] = [], used: string[] = [], failed: string[] = []
  const seen = new Set<string>()
  for (const p of paths || []) {
    if (images.length >= max) break
    const s = String(p == null ? '' : p)
    if (!s || seen.has(s)) continue
    seen.add(s)
    const data = readLocalPng(s)
    if (!data) { failed.push(s + '（读不到）'); continue }
    const att = await toAttachment(ctx, data, tag + '-' + String(Date.now()) + '-' + String(images.length) + '.png')
    if (att.ref) { images.push(att.ref); used.push(s) } else failed.push(s + '（' + String(att.why || '附图失败') + '）')
  }
  return { images, used, failed }
}
/** 无头 see 兜底：走 /worker 的 see op（Workbench 离屏；不依赖 GUI addon）。返回 {text,image} 或 null。 */
async function watchViaWorker(ctx: any, port: number, args: any, session?: string): Promise<any> {
  const size = Math.max(120, Math.min(1600, Number((args && args.max_size) || 420)))
  const spec: any = {
    width: size, height: Math.max(120, Math.round(size * 9 / 16)),
    seconds: Math.max(0.2, Math.min(20, Number((args && args.seconds) || 2))),
    fps: Math.max(0.5, Math.min(8, Number((args && args.fps) || 4))),
    code: args && args.code ? String(args.code) : undefined,
  }
  const nm = session ? String(session) : 'watch'
  try {
    await backendPost(port, '/worker', { op: 'start', name: nm, engine: 'workbench', warmup: true, isolated: true }, 120000)
    const r: any = await backendPost(port, '/worker', { op: 'watch', name: nm, spec: spec, isolated: true }, 180000)
    const res = (r && r.result) || {}
    if (!r || r.ok !== true || res.ok !== true) return { text: 'WATCH 无头失败 · ' + String((r && (r.error || res.error)) || 'unknown') }
    const fr: any[] = res.frames || []
    const hashes = fr.filter((x) => x && x.ok).map((x) => x.hash)
    const distinct = new Set(hashes).size
    const parts: string[] = []
    if (res.code) parts.push('code: ' + (res.code.ok ? 'ok' : '失败') + (res.code.error ? ' · ' + String(res.code.error) : ''))
    parts.push('WATCH(headless) ' + String(res.sampled || fr.length) + ' 帧 · 不同画面 ' + String(distinct) + '/' + String(hashes.length)
      + ' · ' + String(res.ms || 0) + 'ms' + (res.static_render ? ' · 无动画帧范围，静态重复采样' : ''))
    parts.push('timeline: ' + fr.slice(0, 16).map((x) => String(x.frame) + ':' + String(x.hash)).join(' '))
    const images: any[] = []
    let whyNot = ''
    const picks = Array.isArray(res.picks) ? res.picks.slice(0, 6) : []
    for (let i = 0; i < picks.length; i++) {
      const p = picks[i]
      let data: Uint8Array | null = null
      if (p.png_b64) { try { data = Buffer.from(String(p.png_b64), 'base64') } catch (e) { data = null } }
      if (!data && p.path) data = readLocalPng(p.path)
      if (!data) { if (!whyNot) whyNot = '无 png_b64/path'; continue }
      const att = await toAttachment(ctx, data, 'watch-hl-' + String(p.frame) + '-' + String(p.hash) + '.png')
      if (att.ref) images.push(att.ref)
      else if (!whyNot) whyNot = att.why
    }
    parts.push('附帧：' + String(images.length) + ' 张' + (whyNot ? ' · ⚠ ' + whyNot : ''))
    return images.length ? { text: parts.join(String.fromCharCode(10)), images: images } : { text: parts.join(String.fromCharCode(10)) }
  } catch (e) {
    return { text: 'WATCH 无头异常 · ' + String((e && e.message) || e) }
  }
}
async function seeViaWorker(ctx: any, port: number, spec: any, name?: string): Promise<any | null> {
  try {
    const r: any = await backendPost(port, '/worker', { op: 'see', name: name || 'default', spec: spec || {}, isolated: true }, 90000)
    if (!r || r.ok !== true) return null
    const res = (r.result && typeof r.result === 'object') ? r.result : {}
    if (res.ok === false) return { text: '无头 see 失败 · ' + String(res.error || 'unknown') + (res.traceback ? String.fromCharCode(10) + String(res.traceback).slice(-1200) : '') }
    let data: Uint8Array | null = null
    if (res.png_b64) { try { data = Buffer.from(String(res.png_b64), 'base64') } catch (e) { data = null } }
    if (!data && res.path) data = readLocalPng(res.path)
    const att = data ? await toAttachment(ctx, data, 'headless-see-' + String(Date.now()) + '.png') : { why: '没有 png_b64/path' }
    const text = '无头 see（Workbench 离屏，GUI 未连接自动降级）· ' + String(res.ms) + 'ms · ' + String(res.width) + 'x' + String(res.height)
      + ' · ' + String(res.bytes || 0) + 'B' + (res.coverage_estimate === null || res.coverage_estimate === undefined ? '' : (' · 覆盖 ' + (Number(res.coverage_estimate) * 100).toFixed(2) + '%'))
      + ' · 场景与用户视口未改动'
    return att.ref ? { text: text, image: att.ref } : { text: text + String.fromCharCode(10) + '⚠ 图片未回传：' + String(att.why || '未知原因') }
  } catch (e) {
    return null
  }
}

/** 交互式无头一步：exec 代码 + 可选 see（持久 worker；不是 job / 不是异步回合）。 */
async function doViaSession(ctx: any, port: number, opts: any): Promise<any | null> {
  try {
    const nm = String(opts.session || 'interactive')
    const preload = opts.preload ? String(opts.preload) : ''
    if (preload) {
      const st: any = await backendPost(port, '/worker', { op: 'start', name: nm, preload: preload, engine: 'workbench', warmup: true, isolated: true }, 120000)
      if (!st || st.ok !== true) return { text: '无头会话启动失败 · ' + String((st && (st.error || st.raw)) || 'unknown') }
    }
    let code = String(opts.code || '')
    if (!code && opts.file) {
      const data = readLocalPng(opts.file)
      if (!data) return { text: '读不到脚本文件：' + String(opts.file) }
      code = Buffer.from(data).toString('utf8')
    }
    if (!code) return null
    const r: any = await backendPost(port, '/worker', { op: 'exec', name: nm, code: code, isolated: true }, 180000)
    const rr = (r && r.result) || {}
    if (!r || r.ok !== true) {
      return { text: 'ACT(session) 失败 · ' + String((r && (r.error || rr.error)) || 'unknown') + (rr.traceback ? String.fromCharCode(10) + String(rr.traceback).slice(-1800) : '') }
    }
    const parts: string[] = ['ACT(session=' + nm + ') ok · ' + String(rr.ms) + 'ms']
    if (rr.stdout && String(rr.stdout).trim()) parts.push('stdout: ' + String(rr.stdout).trim().slice(0, 3000))
    if (rr.stderr && String(rr.stderr).trim()) parts.push('stderr: ' + String(rr.stderr).trim().slice(0, 1200))
    let image: any = undefined
    const see = opts.see !== false
    if (see) {
      const size = Math.max(120, Math.min(1600, Number(opts.max_size || 560)))
      const spec: any = {
        from: numTriple(opts.from) || [7, -7, 5],
        look_at: numTriple(opts.look_at) || [0, 0, 1],
        lens: opts.lens === undefined ? undefined : Number(opts.lens),
        ortho: opts.ortho === undefined ? undefined : !!opts.ortho,
        ortho_scale: opts.ortho_scale === undefined ? undefined : Number(opts.ortho_scale),
        width: size, height: Math.max(120, Math.round(size * 9 / 16)),
      }
      const vs = String(opts.view_size || '')
      const mm = vs.match(/^(\d+)\s*[x×]\s*(\d+)$/)
      if (mm) { spec.width = Number(mm[1]); spec.height = Number(mm[2]) }
      const sr: any = await backendPost(port, '/worker', { op: 'see', name: nm, spec: spec, isolated: true }, 90000)
      const sres = (sr && sr.result) || {}
      if (sres.ok !== false) {
        let data: Uint8Array | null = null
        if (sres.png_b64) { try { data = Buffer.from(String(sres.png_b64), 'base64') } catch (e) { data = null } }
        if (!data && sres.path) data = readLocalPng(sres.path)
        const att = data ? await toAttachment(ctx, data, 'session-see-' + String(Date.now()) + '.png') : { why: '没有 png_b64/path' }
        if (att.ref) image = att.ref
        parts.push('SEE(session) ' + String(spec.width) + 'x' + String(spec.height) + ' · ' + String(sres.ms) + 'ms'
          + (sres.coverage_estimate === null || sres.coverage_estimate === undefined ? '' : (' · 覆盖 ' + (Number(sres.coverage_estimate) * 100).toFixed(2) + '%')))
        if (!image) parts.push('⚠ 图片未回传：' + String(att.why || '未知原因'))
      } else {
        parts.push('SEE(session) 失败: ' + String(sres.error || 'unknown'))
      }
    }
    const out: any = { text: parts.join(String.fromCharCode(10)) }
    if (image) out.image = image
    return out
  } catch (e) {
    return null
  }
}

/** 从 plan 回执里收集可附图路径（≤2 张；只认常见产物字段） */
function planImagePaths(res: any): string[] {
  const r = (res && typeof res === 'object') ? res : {}
  const out: string[] = []
  const push = (x: any) => { const s = typeof x === 'string' ? x : (x && (x.path || x.crop || x.out || x.file)); if (s) out.push(String(s)) }
  if (Array.isArray(r.images)) for (const x of r.images) push(x)
  else if (r.images && typeof r.images === 'object') {
    for (const k of ['overlay', 'sheet', 'crops', 'per_view']) {
      const v = r.images[k]
      if (Array.isArray(v)) for (const x of v) push(x)
      else if (v) push(v)
    }
  }
  for (const k of ['overlay', 'sheet', 'diff_heat', 'annotated', 'atlas', 'out']) push(r[k])
  if (Array.isArray(r.crops)) for (const c of r.crops) push(c)
  if (Array.isArray(r.views)) for (const v of r.views) push(v)
  if (r.overlay && r.overlay.path) push(r.overlay.path)
  if (r.sheet && r.sheet.path) push(r.sheet.path)
  return out
}

/** P1：plan op → 无头 worker 的模块 API（不给 GUI 也能跑；op 前缀路由 + 别名） */

const PLAN_HEADLESS_ALIAS: any = {
  qc_visual_report: ['dsh_visualreport_api', 'report', 'visualreport,qc,imgtools'],
  shape_solve: ['dsh_shapesolve_api', 'solve', 'shapesolve,imgtools'],
  fix_clash: ['dsh_assembly_api', 'repair', 'assembly,audit,contract,clearance,gate,mesh_fix,geo,txn'],
  fix_interference: ['dsh_assembly_api', 'fix_interference', 'assembly,audit,contract,clearance,gate,mesh_fix,geo,txn'],
  audit_clash_all: ['dsh_assembly_api', 'scan', 'assembly,audit,contract,clearance,gate,mesh_fix,geo,txn'],
  model_preflight: ['dsh_gate_api', 'preflight', 'gate,audit'],
  model_checkpoint: ['dsh_gate_api', 'checkpoint', 'gate,txn'],
  model_deliver: ['dsh_gate_api', 'deliver', 'gate,audit,txn,deliver'],

function planHeadlessTarget(op: string): any {
  const o = String(op || '')
  if (PLAN_HEADLESS_ALIAS[o]) {
    const a = PLAN_HEADLESS_ALIAS[o]
    return { api: a[0], sub: a[1], preload: a[2] }
  }
  for (const row of PLAN_HEADLESS_MAP) {
    const p = String(row[0])
    if (o.indexOf(p) === 0) return { api: row[1], sub: o.slice(p.length), preload: row[2] }
  }
  return null
}
/** 用持久 worker 执行一个 plan op（不依赖 GUI addon；模块由 preload 注入 K） */
async function planViaWorker(ctx: any, port: number, op: string, payload: any, session?: string): Promise<any> {
  const t = planHeadlessTarget(op)
  if (!t) return { ok: false, error: '该 plan op 没有无头映射（先 op="catalog" 查，或走 GUI 通道）' }
  const nm = session ? String(session) : ('plan-' + String(t.api).replace(/^dsh_|_api$/g, ''))
  try {
    const st: any = await backendPost(port, '/worker', { op: 'start', name: nm, preload: t.preload, engine: 'workbench', warmup: false, isolated: true }, 120000)
    if (!st || st.ok !== true) return { ok: false, error: '无头 worker 启动失败：' + String((st && (st.error || st.raw)) || 'unknown') }
    const code = 'import json as _json\n_s = _json.dumps(_json.loads(' + JSON.stringify(JSON.stringify(payload || {})) + '))\n'
      + '_r = K.' + t.api + '["dispatch"](' + JSON.stringify(String(t.sub)) + ', _s)\n'
      + 'print("HEADLESS " + (_r if isinstance(_r, str) else _json.dumps(_r, ensure_ascii=False)))'
    const r: any = await backendPost(port, '/worker', { op: 'exec', name: nm, code: code, isolated: true }, 900000)
    const rr = (r && r.result) || {}
    if (!r || r.ok !== true) {
      return { ok: false, error: '无头 plan 执行失败：' + String((r && (r.error || rr.error)) || 'unknown'),
               hint: String(rr.traceback || '').slice(-1200) }
    }
    return { ok: true, res: rr.result, via: 'worker:' + nm }
  } catch (e) {
    return { ok: false, error: '无头 plan 异常：' + String((e && e.message) || e) }
  }
}
/** plan 回执统一收尾：信封 + 附图（GUI/无头共用） */
async function finishPlanResponse(ctx: any, op: string, res: any, argsIn: any): Promise<any> {
  const txt = typeof res === 'string' ? res : JSON.stringify(res, null, 1)
  const CAP = 12000
  const env = planEnvelope(op, res)
  const attachWanted = (argsIn && argsIn.attach_images !== undefined)
    ? !!argsIn.attach_images
    : ['img_digest', 'qc_compare', 'visualreport_report', 'qc_visual_report', 'shapesolve_solve'].indexOf(op) >= 0
  let images: any[] = []
  let attachNote = ''
  if (attachWanted) {
    const att = await attachPaths(ctx, planImagePaths(res), 'plan-' + op.replace(/[^a-z0-9_]+/gi, '_'), 2)
    images = att.images
    if (att.used.length) attachNote = String.fromCharCode(10) + '附图：' + String(att.used.length) + ' 张（' + att.used.join(' · ') + '）'
    if (att.failed.length) attachNote += String.fromCharCode(10) + '⚠ 部分图未附：' + att.failed.slice(0, 2).join(' · ')
  }
  const head = 'PLAN ' + op + ' ok · ' + String(txt.length) + ' chars · verdict=' + String(env.verdict)
    + (env.summary ? (' · ' + String(env.summary)) : '') + attachNote + String.fromCharCode(10)
  return {
    text: head + (txt.length > CAP ? txt.slice(0, CAP) + String.fromCharCode(10) + '…[已截断，共 ' + String(txt.length) + ' 字符；结构化全量见后端 results/ 目录或用 headless(outJson=…) 落盘]' : txt),
    envelope: env,
    ...(images.length ? { images: images } : {}),
  }
}
/** 弱模型契约 v2：verdict-first 信封（单行、≤2k）——plan 与 headless 共用口径 */
function planEnvelope(op: string, res: any): any {
  const r = (res && typeof res === 'object') ? res : { value: res }
  const verdict = r.verdict || r.state || (r.ok === false ? 'fail' : (r.ok === true ? (r.clean === false ? 'degraded' : 'pass') : null))
  let defects: any[] = []
  for (const k of ['top_defects', 'offenders', 'defects', 'failures', 'errors']) {
    if (Array.isArray(r[k])) { defects = r[k]; break }
  }
  const limit = (t: any, n: number) => String(t == null ? '' : t).slice(0, n)
  const top = defects.slice(0, 5).map((d: any, i: number) => {
    if (!d || typeof d !== 'object') return { id: 'D' + String(i + 1), code: limit(d, 80) }
    return {
      id: d.id || ('D' + String(i + 1)),
      code: limit(d.code || d.kind || d.class || d.error || 'issue', 60),
      severity: d.severity || null,
      object: d.object || d.a || d.name || null,
      measured: d.measured || (d.volume_mm3 !== undefined ? { volume_mm3: d.volume_mm3 } : (d.depth_mm !== undefined ? { depth_mm: d.depth_mm } : null)),
      fix_hint: d.fix_hint || d.repair || null,
    }
  })
  const next = (Array.isArray(r.next) ? r.next : (Array.isArray(r.repairs) ? r.repairs : []))
    .slice(0, 3).map((x: any) => (typeof x === 'string' ? { op: limit(x, 120) } : { op: limit(x.op || x.name || 'next', 80), args: x.args || null, why: limit(x.why || '', 120) }))
  const env: any = {
    contract: 'receipt.v2', op: op, verdict: verdict,
    summary: limit(r.summary || r.note || r.error || r.hint || '', 160),
    top_defects: top,
    next: next,
    images: planImagePaths(r).slice(0, 2),
    provenance: { ms: (typeof r.ms === 'number' ? r.ms : null) },
  }
  const counts = r.counts || (r.totals ? r.totals : null)
  if (counts && typeof counts === 'object') env.counts = counts
  if (r.detail && typeof r.detail === 'object') env.detail = { path: r.detail.path || null, bytes: r.detail.bytes || null, id: r.detail.id || null }
  // 信封硬预算：超过 2k 就只保留最有用的三块（verdict / top3 / next2）
  try {
    if (JSON.stringify(env).length > 2000) {
      env.top_defects = top.slice(0, 3)
      env.next = next.slice(0, 2)
      delete env.counts
      if (env.detail && env.detail.bytes && env.detail.bytes > 0) { /* keep path only */ } else delete env.detail
    }
  } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
  return env
}

function renderOne(_args: unknown, value: any): any[] {
  const blocks: any[] = [{ type: 'text', text: String((value && value.text) || '') }]
  if (value && value.image) blocks.push({ type: 'image', attachment: value.image })
  if (value && Array.isArray(value.images)) for (const im of value.images) blocks.push({ type: 'image', attachment: im })
  return blocks
}

/* ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * v0.9.3（D2）：结构化回执 —— **两个 text block**
 *   block 0 = 单行 JSON 信封（可直接 JSON.parse，字段稳定；不必再手写正则从
 *             "中文前言 + stdout 尾 + result: {...}" 里抠）
 *   block 1 = 人读摘要（原样保留旧版的叙述性文本）
 * 为什么用两个 block：宿主对 tool 结果只透传 ContentBlock[]（text/image/file），
 * 没有 json block；而**每个 text block 在 provider 侧是一个独立的 text part**，
 * 所以"第一块就是纯 JSON"等价于"调用方拿得到一个可解析的结构化回执"。
 * ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */

/** 安全 JSON.stringify（循环引用/大对象不炸；超长返回 null 由调用方给路径） */
function safeStringify(v: any): string | null {
  try { return JSON.stringify(v) } catch (e) { return null }
}
/** 截断（保留头尾，中间省略标记）—— 与后端 clipMiddle 同一口径 */
function clipText(s: any, head: number, tail: number): string {
  const t = String(s == null ? '' : s)
  if (t.length <= head + tail) return t
  return t.slice(0, head) + String.fromCharCode(10) + '…[中间省略 ' + String(t.length - head - tail) + ' 字符]…' + String.fromCharCode(10) + t.slice(-tail)
}
/** 带结构化信封的工具回执：value = {text, envelope?, image?, images?} */
function renderStructured(_args: unknown, value: any): any[] {
  const blocks: any[] = []
  if (value && value.envelope) {
    const s = safeStringify(value.envelope)
    if (s) blocks.push({ type: 'text', text: s })
  }
  blocks.push({ type: 'text', text: String((value && value.text) || '') })
  if (value && value.image) blocks.push({ type: 'image', attachment: value.image })
  if (value && Array.isArray(value.images)) for (const im of value.images) blocks.push({ type: 'image', attachment: im })
  return blocks
}

/* ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 * v2.6.1（工具卡片）：presentCall / presentResult —— **只管给人看的卡片**，模型侧回执
 * （render 的输出）一个字节都不动。宿主（dsh-TUI / Web）没有这两个方法时显示的是
 * `Blender_rt_do({"code":"import bpy\n…"})` 这种整段 JSON 参数 + 原始回执（含单行 JSON 信封）。
 *   - 调用卡片：标题写成「Blender <动作> · <要点>」；带代码的调用把代码放进卡片正文。
 *   - 结果卡片：去掉 renderStructured 的单行 JSON 信封（那是给模型 JSON.parse 的），
 *     人读摘要放最前（TUI 折叠态只显示前 3 行），代码附在后面，图片块原样透传。
 * 纯函数、只依赖 args / result（宿主回放会话日志时也会调）；任何异常都回 undefined ⇒ 宿主退回通用卡片。
 * ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
const CARD_DETAIL_MAX = 48
/** 卡片正文里代码的上限（头 + 尾，中间省略）：几千行脚本不该把卡片撑爆 */
const CARD_CODE_HEAD = 3000
const CARD_CODE_TAIL = 1000

/** 压成一行并截断（卡片标题只放一行） */
function cardClip(v: any, max = CARD_DETAIL_MAX): string {
  const one = String(v == null ? '' : v).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim()
  return one.length > max ? one.slice(0, max - 1) + '…' : one
}
/** 代码 → 「首个有意义的行（+N 行）」；全是注释/空行时回空串 */
function cardCodeHeadline(code: any): string {
  const lines = String(code == null ? '' : code).split(String.fromCharCode(10)).map((l) => l.trim()).filter(Boolean)
  const first = lines.find((l) => !l.startsWith('#'))
  if (!first) return ''
  return cardClip(first) + (lines.length > 1 ? '（+' + String(lines.length - 1) + ' 行）' : '')
}
/** 路径 → 文件名（Windows / POSIX 分隔符都认） */
function cardBaseName(p: any): string {
  const parts = String(p == null ? '' : p).split(/[\\/]/)
  return parts[parts.length - 1] || ''
}
/** rt_cmd 的 params：对象列前 3 个键，字符串截一行 */
function cardParams(p: any): string {
  if (p && typeof p === 'object' && !Array.isArray(p)) {
    const keys = Object.keys(p)
    return keys.length ? '{' + keys.slice(0, 3).join(', ') + (keys.length > 3 ? ', …' : '') + '}' : ''
  }
  return typeof p === 'string' ? cardClip(p, 32) : ''
}
/** 「头 · 要点1 · 要点2」，空要点跳过 */
function cardTitle(head: string, parts: any[]): string {
  const tail = parts.map((x) => cardClip(x)).filter(Boolean)
  return tail.length ? head + ' · ' + tail.join(' · ') : head
}
const cardSession = (a: any): string => (a.session ? '无头 ' + cardClip(a.session, 24) : '')
const cardPython = (code: any): any => (typeof code === 'string' && code.trim() ? { label: 'Python', code: code } : null)

interface CardSpec {

/** 卡片正文里的代码段：一行标签 + 原样代码（过长时保留头尾） */
function cardCodeSection(code: { label: string; code: string }): string {
  const body = code.code.replace(/\s+$/, '')
  const n = body.split(String.fromCharCode(10)).length
  return '▸ ' + code.label + '（' + String(n) + ' 行）' + String.fromCharCode(10) + clipText(body, CARD_CODE_HEAD, CARD_CODE_TAIL)
}
/** renderStructured 的第 0 块：单行、能 parse 成普通对象的 JSON */
function isEnvelopeBlock(b: any): boolean {
  if (!b || b.type !== 'text' || typeof b.text !== 'string') return false
  const s = b.text.trim()
  if (!s.startsWith('{') || !s.endsWith('}') || s.indexOf(String.fromCharCode(10)) >= 0) return false
  try {
    const v = JSON.parse(s)
    return !!v && typeof v === 'object' && !Array.isArray(v)
  } catch (e) { return false }
}

/** vTool 用：按工具名给出 presentCall / presentResult（未登记的工具 / spec 自带的不覆盖） */
function cardPresenters(spec: any): any {
  const card = spec && CARD_SPECS[spec.name]
  if (!card) return {}
  const out: any = {}
  if (!spec.presentCall) {
    out.presentCall = (args: any) => {
      try {
        const a = args && typeof args === 'object' ? args : {}
        const view: any = { card: 'generic', title: card.title(a), kind: card.kind }
        const code = card.code ? card.code(a) : null
        if (code) view.content = [{ type: 'text', text: cardCodeSection(code) }]
        return view
      } catch (e) { return undefined }
    }
  }
  if (!spec.presentResult) {
    out.presentResult = (args: any, result: any) => {
      try {
        if (!result || result.isError || !Array.isArray(result.content)) return undefined
        const texts = result.content.filter((b: any) => b && b.type === 'text')
        const human = texts.length > 1 && isEnvelopeBlock(texts[0]) ? texts.slice(1) : texts
        const a = args && typeof args === 'object' ? args : {}
        const code = card.code ? card.code(a) : null

        const parts = human.map((b: any) => String(b.text || '').replace(/\s+$/, '')).filter(Boolean)

        const content: any[] = parts.length ? [{ type: 'text', text: parts.join(String.fromCharCode(10, 10)) }] : []

/**
 * v0.9.3（D1/F3）：客户端单次等待上限。超过它就**不干等**，转作业层并回 jobId（对齐 bash 的 promoted 语义）。

const HEADLESS_WAIT_MS = (() => {
  const n = Number(process.env.DSH_HEADLESS_WAIT_MS)
  // 下限 1000ms：验收测试会把它调到秒级来复现 promoted 路径（别把合法的小窗口当成脏值）
  return Number.isFinite(n) && n >= 1000 ? n : 100000

async function startJobThenMaybeWait(port: number, body: any, waitS: number | null): Promise<any> {
  const jr: any = await backendPost(port, '/headless', Object.assign({}, body, { asJob: true }), 60000)
  const lt = leasedText(jr)
  if (lt) return { text: lt }
  if (!jr || jr.error) return { text: 'HEADLESS 转作业层失败 · ' + String((jr && (jr.error || jr.raw)) || 'unknown') }
  // 后端 /headless 的回包是 {ok, ms, result:<引擎回执>} —— jobId 在 result 里
  const inner: any = (jr.result && typeof jr.result === 'object') ? jr.result : jr

  if (!budget) return { jobId: jobId, job: inner.job || null, waited: false }
  const wr: any = await backendPost(port, '/job', { op: 'wait', id: jobId, timeoutMs: budget }, budget + 30000)
  const lt2 = leasedText(wr)
  if (lt2) return { text: lt2 }
  const job = (wr && wr.job) || null
  if (job && job.status && job.status !== 'running') return { jobId: jobId, job: job, waited: true, finished: true }
  return { jobId: jobId, job: job || inner.job || null, waited: true, finished: false }
}

/** 人读摘要（block 1）—— 沿用 v0.9.2 的叙述口径，读的是 v0.9.3 的结构化字段 */
function headlessHumanText(res: any, ctx: any): string {
  const r: any = res || {}
  const NLx = String.fromCharCode(10)
  const parts: string[] = []
  const okFlag = (typeof r.ok === 'boolean') ? r.ok
    : ((r.status === 'done' || r.status === 'finished') ? true
      : ((r.status === 'failed' || r.status === 'killed' || r.status === 'timeout' || r.status === 'stale') ? false : null))
  const st = r.status || (okFlag ? 'finished' : 'unknown')
  parts.push((okFlag === true ? 'HEADLESS ok' : (okFlag === false ? 'HEADLESS 失败' : 'HEADLESS 进行中')) + ' · status=' + String(st)
    + (r.exitCode === undefined || r.exitCode === null ? '' : (' · exit=' + String(r.exitCode)))
    + (r.timedOut ? ' · 超时被杀' : '')
    + (typeof r.ms === 'number' ? (' · ' + String(r.ms) + 'ms') : '')
    + (r.reason ? (' · ' + String(r.reason)) : ''))
  if (ctx && ctx.mode === 'job') parts.push('模式：作业层（jobId=' + String(ctx.jobId || '') + '，等待窗口内已完成）')
  if (r.failure_hint) parts.push('提示：' + String(r.failure_hint))
  if (r.session) parts.push('会话：' + String(r.session))
  if (r.script) parts.push('脚本：' + String(r.script))
  if (r.scriptFile) parts.push('脚本文件：' + String(r.scriptFile.resolved || r.scriptFile.given) + '（' + String(r.scriptFile.bytes) + ' 字节）')
  if (r.inputFile && r.inputFile.md5) parts.push('输入文件：' + String(r.inputFile.path) + ' · ' + String(r.inputFile.size) + ' 字节 · mtime=' + String(r.inputFile.mtime || r.inputFile.mtimeMs) + ' · md5=' + String(r.inputFile.md5) + (r.inputFile.md5Partial ? '（部分哈希）' : ''))
  const engName = r.engine || (r.gpu && r.gpu.after && r.gpu.after.engine) || null
  if (engName) parts.push('引擎：' + String(engName) + (r.engineMode ? ('（mode=' + String(r.engineMode) + '）') : ''))
  if (r.gpu) {
    const g = r.gpu
    parts.push('GPU：' + (g.fell_back_to_cpu ? ('⚠️ 回落 CPU（' + String(g.error || (g.before && g.before.device_type) || '') + '）')
      : ('✅ ' + String((g.after && g.after.device_type) || g.configured || '') + ' · ' + String(((g.after && g.after.gpu_enabled) || []).join(','))))
      + (g.configured ? (' · 本次已自动配置 ' + String(g.configured)) : ''))
  }
  if (r.stage || r.stageName) parts.push('最后阶段（stage）：' + safeStringify(r.stage || r.stageName))
  if (r.lastException) parts.push('最后异常：' + String(r.lastException))
  if (r.logs) parts.push('日志：' + String(r.logs.stdout || '') + ' · ' + String(r.logs.stderr || ''))
  const rj = (r.resultJson !== undefined) ? r.resultJson : r.result
  if (rj !== null && rj !== undefined) {
    const s = safeStringify(rj) || ''
    parts.push('result: ' + (s.length > 6000 ? (s.slice(0, 6000) + NLx + '…[result 共 ' + String(s.length) + ' 字符；全文见 resultPath]') : s))

  if (r.resultParseError) parts.push('⚠️ 末行 HEADLESS 不是合法 JSON（**原始输出已保留**，见下面的 stdout）· ' + String(r.resultParseError.message || '') + NLx + '  该行：' + String(r.resultParseError.line || '').slice(0, 300))

          + (typeof x.coverage_estimate === 'number' ? (' · coverage=' + (x.coverage_estimate * 100).toFixed(2) + '%') : '')
          + (x.warning ? ('  ⚠️ ' + String((x.warning && x.warning.hint) || x.warning.code)) : '')).join(NLx))
    if (r.shots.jsonl) parts.push('shots jsonl：' + String(r.shots.jsonl))
  } else if (r.shots && r.shots.error) parts.push('⚠️ shots 失败：' + String(r.shots.error))

      + r.pathWarnings.map((w: any) => '  · ' + String(w.code) + ' · ' + String(w.evidence || w.value || '') + NLx + '    ' + String(w.hint || '')).join(NLx))

      + (obs.delta ? (' · 新增对象 ' + String(obs.delta.objects) + ' / 网格 ' + String(obs.delta.meshes) + '（before ' + String((obs.before || {}).objects) + ' → after ' + String((obs.after || {}).objects) + '）') : '')
      + ((ex.warnings || []).length ? (NLx + '  ' + ex.warnings.join(NLx + '  ')) : ''))
  }
  const arts = Array.isArray(r.artifacts) ? r.artifacts : []
  if (arts.length) parts.push('产物：' + arts.slice(0, 12).map((a: any) => (typeof a === 'string' ? a : (a.name + '(' + a.bytes + 'B' + (a.fresh ? ' 新' : '') + ')'))).join(' · '))
  if (r.noiseFiltered) parts.push('（已过滤 ' + String(r.noiseFiltered) + ' 个噪音产物）')
  if (r.hint) parts.push('提示：' + String(r.hint))
  if (r.traceback) parts.push('--- traceback ---' + NLx + String(r.traceback).slice(0, 1200))
  if (r.id && String(r.id).indexOf('job-') === 0) parts.push('作业号：' + String(r.id) + '（runId=' + String(r.runId || '-') + '）')
  if (r.runId) parts.push('运行号：' + String(r.runId) + '（blender_rt_job(op="status"/"collect"/"wait", id=…) 可查；后端重启后也能从磁盘台账查到）')
  if (Array.isArray(ctx && ctx.notes)) for (const n of ctx.notes) parts.push('· ' + String(n))

}
/** 无头回执（sync / 作业层完成）：{text, envelope} —— 两个 text block 的来源 */

}

 */
function promotedReceipt(job: any, jobId: string, why: string): any {
  const NLx = String.fromCharCode(10)
  const j: any = job || {}
  const st = j.status || 'running'
  const logs = j.logs || (j.stdoutLog ? { stdout: j.stdoutLog, stderr: j.stderrLog } : null)
  const env: any = {
    kind: 'promoted', mode: 'promoted', promoted: true, status: st, ok: null,
    jobId: jobId, runId: j.runId || jobId, id: j.id || jobId,
    ms: (typeof j.ms === 'number') ? j.ms : null,
    stage: j.stage || j.stageName || null,
    idleMs: (typeof j.idleMs === 'number') ? j.idleMs : null,
    lines: (typeof j.lines === 'number') ? j.lines : null,
    logBytes: (typeof j.logBytes === 'number') ? j.logBytes : null,
    resultJson: j.resultJson || null, resultTruncated: !!j.resultTruncated,
    resultPath: j.resultPath || null, resultPathWsl: j.resultPathWsl || null,
    stdoutTail: clipText(j.stdoutTail, 1200, 1200), stderrTail: clipText(j.stderrTail, 800, 800),
    logs: logs, outdir: j.outdir || null, artifacts: (j.artifacts || []).slice(0, 40),
    shots: normalizeShots(j.shots), inputFile: j.inputFile || null,
    pathWarnings: j.pathWarnings || [],
    hint: '用 blender_rt_job(op="wait", id="' + jobId + '") 阻塞等结果，或 op="collect" 看进展（stage/idleMs）；op="list" 看全部作业',
    notes: [why],
  }
  const parts: string[] = []
  parts.push('⏳ 已后台化（**不是失败**）· ' + why)
  parts.push('句柄：' + jobId + ' · status=' + String(st)
    + (env.stage ? (' · stage=' + safeStringify(env.stage)) : '')
    + (typeof env.idleMs === 'number' ? (' · 最近输出 ' + String(Math.round(env.idleMs / 1000)) + 's 前') : ''))
  if (logs) parts.push('日志（运行期就有增量：PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1）：' + String(logs.stdout || '') + ' · ' + String(logs.stderr || ''))
  if (env.stdoutTail) parts.push('--- stdout 尾 ---' + NLx + String(env.stdoutTail).slice(-1500))
  parts.push('收结果：blender_rt_job(op="wait", id="' + jobId + '", timeout_ms=120000) —— 阻塞到完成或超时（不要连发 status 轮询，会撞重复调用检测）；'
    + '也可 op="collect"（随时看，未完成时也能看到 stage/日志尾），op="kill" 中止。'
    + ' ⚠ 这个 id 是**Blender 侧台账** id，不是 DSH 的作业 id —— 拿它去 DSH 的 job_output 会回 unknown job。')
  parts.push('提醒：下次这类长活直接 as_job=true（预期 >100 s 都建议），就不会占用调用窗口。')

}
/**
 * v0.9.3（D1）：客户端等待窗口到点 / 宿主取消时的兜底 —— 先问一句服务端状态：
 *   已结束 → 直接 collect 把结果拿回来（窗口与完成是赛跑，可能刚好赶上）；
 *   还在跑 → 回 promoted 回执（runId 是客户端生成的，句柄一定有效）。
 */
async function promotedFromTimeout(port: number, runId: string, err: any): Promise<any> {
  const msg = String((err && err.message) || err)
  const job = await fetchJobStatus(port, runId)
  if (job && job.status && job.status !== 'running' && job.status !== 'unknown') {
    try {
      const cr: any = await backendJson(port, '/job', 15000, {
        method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ op: 'collect', id: runId, holder: HOLDER }),
      })
      const cj = (cr && cr.job) || null
      if (cj && cj.status && cj.status !== 'running') {
        return headlessReceipt(cj, { mode: 'sync', jobId: null, runId: runId,
          notes: ['客户端窗口到点时任务其实已经跑完 → 已直接取回结果（' + msg + '）'] })
      }
    } catch (e2) { /* 取不回来就走 promoted */ }
  }
  return promotedReceipt(job, runId, '客户端等待窗口到点或宿主取消：' + msg)
}

/** 取某个 id（run-… / job-…）的状态快照（拿不到就返回 null，绝不抛） */
async function fetchJobStatus(port: number, id: string): Promise<any> {
  try {
    const r: any = await backendJson(port, '/job', 8000, {
      method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ op: 'status', id: id, holder: HOLDER }),
    })
    return (r && r.job) || null
  } catch (e) { return null }
}
